task: Issue #50: Semantic reconstruction quality vs L1 Hard ER for Stage 3 Recall

feature_definitions.N_sem: Tie-aware expected Top-20 text-neighbor prefix overlap under uniform random tie-breaking
feature_definitions.semantic_AUC: Semantic pair discrimination AUC between Top-20 text positives and matched negatives
feature_definitions.R_cos_uniform: Catalogue-uniform mean cosine similarity between Sentence-T5 and faithful 3-token SID reconstruction
feature_definitions.R_mse_uniform: Catalogue-uniform mean squared error per item dimension (diff_sq / 768)
feature_definitions.log_er_l1: Natural logarithm of held-out valid L1 Hard behavioral ER (from #49 audited recheck)

lofo_protocol.model: Ridge (train-fold-only standardization, inner grouped CV alpha grid [0.1, 1.0, 10.0, 100.0])

subsets.recon_32: M0 (log_er_l1) vs M8 (log_er_l1 + R_cos) vs M10 (log_er_l1 + R_cos + log_er_l1:R_cos)
